title: The Eval Overlap
briefMd:
# The Eval Overlap

Same frozen 40-ticket set. Same checkpoint. Same seed. No live model calls.

Harness **B** prepends eight “train dump” support tickets as few-shot examples. Those shots were written in the same style as **12 of the 40 eval tickets** (near-paraphrases). Harness **A** is clean — no shots.

| Harness | Setup | Headline |
|---|---|---|
| **A** `clean` | no wrapper · seed 1 | **24/40 (60.0%)** |
| **B** `leaky-fewshot` | eval-like shots · seed 1 | **32/40 (80.0%)** |

B looks like a +20 pp win. Overall 95% Wilson intervals **overlap**. That is not the lesson — read the **clean vs overlap slices** on the scorecard.

Pass (class A) when you call the run **contaminated** and name **eval overlap** — not a better model, and not “noise because CIs overlap”. Wall-clock is information, not a gate.
